lyrics:
[Verse]
 O glorious victory
That day He set me free,
And made my heart His very throne,
My life is no longer mine,
Im a prisoner of love divine
And now I live to praise His name.
[Verse]
[Verse]
[Chorus]
Who I am, Lord, who I am,
I can see now, who I am,
A part of my Saviour
A part of His Word,
Its a revelation
(Its predestination)
Of who I am.
[Verse]
[Verse]
On Calvary He died
To redeem His lost Bride
The King of kings
Became my Saviour,
This is Gods great mystery,
Of love expressed to me,
That Christ and I
Might be made one!
